title: CIA-UAP-005, German Scientist's Article on 'Flying Discs'
what_is_it: CIA Information Report summarizing a German scientist's published article theorizing about the aerodynamic principles behind 'Flying Discs'.
interpretation_warnings: The OCR extraction is extremely degraded, rendering most of the body text illegible; key facts are supplemented from the official CSV description provided by war.gov.
The German scientist is not named in the legible portions of the text.
This is a single-source intelligence report summarizing a published article, not a direct observation or investigation of any UAP event.
Heavy redaction is present throughout the document, obscuring source details and much of the analytical content.
A redacted version of this report was previously available on the CIA's public website.

key_facts.source_quote: CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY REPORT NO. SO B-273 INFORMATION REPORT

key_facts.value: German scientist's article on Flying Discs

verifiable_claims.claim: A German scientist published an article proposing that Flying Discs could be explained as aircraft using aerodynamic principles from German research facilities.
The report was classified SECRET and consisted of one page.
